name: Poll
summary: Run a live poll in the channel and watch the bars fill in.
description: Launch a poll from the apps menu (or type /poll Question? | option a, option b) and vote together - tap a bar to add your vote and everyone watching sees the tally update. 'close poll' stops further taps and shows the final result; 'reset' clears it and starts over. Every tap is one sandboxed frame, so the tally lives in the scene's own state rather than anywhere on the host.
author: slim-m
